chunks.text: Last spring I was in Beijing and my cousin kept talking about what sports events were on around town—felt like the whole city was buzzing.
One night we ended up at that CSL match, Beijing Guoan vs Shanghai Shenhua—funny thing is I sat in the Away Stand even though I’m not really a die-hard.
It was just a single ticket too—ticket_count was 1—my friend handled it, I basically just showed up and followed along.
I remember the ticket was under Zhang Wei, and the phone on the order was 13845678901—he was laughing about how many texts he got that day.
He even had to type in his ID number for it—330102199708085678—and he complained the whole time about copying it carefully.
Then earlier in 2025 I was down in Chengdu, and everyone around me was chatting about car options like it was the main topic of the trip.
We actually ended up with a Toyota Camry; pickup_date was 2025-03-04, we kept it for 8 days, and it was rented under Chen Ming—already all done and returned ages ago.

Back in Beijing again, I remember people mentioning parking and even doctors in passing—like someone was comparing China World Trade Center Parking and talking about a visit they had in Shanghai; anyway the parking reservation I used was already set for 2025-03-25 09:00 for 2 hours, plate 浙E34567, driver phone 13877949128.
